subject: slender elf archer in a green hooded cloak with a tall recurve longbow in the left hand and a quiver on the back
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a small dust cloud along the roll

plan.source: Three-quarter right; standing relaxed. Left hand holds a tall bow near vertical in front, right arm bent back by the quiver, left leg forward, right back, head looking right.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso dips and shifts back; left foot planted, right toe slides slightly back. Left arm pulls bow in, tilting it back; right hand drops from quiver across ribs; head lowers.
frames.effect: Small dust scuff at right heel.

frames.pose: Key: dive into roll; both feet off. Torso pitched forward-right, head tucked; left arm clamps bow across chest near horizontal; right arm wraps over it to protect.
frames.effect: Puff at takeoff under left toe trailing rightward.

frames.pose: Mid-roll: inverted tuck; shoulders low near ground, hips up; both feet tucked. Bow kept tight and parallel to ground in left; right forearm bracing; head turns toward landing.
frames.effect: Low dust arc along ground under shoulders, trailing right.

frames.pose: Recovery: rise from roll to low crouch facing right; left foot planted forward, right knee under on toe; torso lifting, head up. Left brings bow back toward vertical ahead; right hand lifts toward quiver.
frames.effect: Small settling dust puff behind hips/right toe.
